facts.fact: The ministry says its schemes cover families eligible under the Social Register of Mauritius, which gates the Subsistence Allowance and other schemes.
The ministry lists the Subsistence Allowance, Bread Price Relief, Child Allowance and other schemes as drawn from households registered or eligible under the Social Register of Mauritius.
The ministry says a Rs 1,000 monthly grant for infants is credited to the bank account of eligible Social Register households.
